recreation_brief:
1) Slide 16:9, white background. Draw a thin (~1.5pt) dark-red #C00000 rectangle as a frame inset ~4% from all edges.
2) Vertical title: text box 'Encoder Block', bold sans (Calibri), ~40pt, red #CC0000, rotated 270° (reads bottom-to-top), centered on the left edge (~x 9–12%, y 21–78%).
3) Top-left: small white rectangle, 2pt red border, red bold ~13pt text 'Block Output'. Bottom-left: identical box with 'Block Input'.
4) Main container: rounded rectangle, fill #F5B36E, ~3pt border #E06A10, spanning ~12.5%–92% width and ~17.5%–87% height.
5) Bottom input row (below container): 16 small boxes (~44×22px) fill #FFFDE7 with thin gray borders; labels left→right in dark bold italic math font (Cambria Math): X₁, X₁′, X₂, X₂′, X₃, X₃′, X₄, X₄′, X₅, X₅′, X₆, X₆′; then 5 green #00B050 dots (~6px); then X_{N−2}, X_{N−2}′, X_{N−1}, X_{N−1}′.
6) Near the container's bottom draw a full-width bar, fill #7B2A5E, with white bold ~18pt centered text 'Multi Head Self Attention Block'.
7) Above it place Y row C: 16 boxes styled as in step 5 but with red #CC0000 labels: Ỹ₁, Y₁, Ỹ₂, Y₂, Ỹ₃, Y₃, Ỹ₄, Y₄, Ỹ₅, Y₅, Ỹ₆, Y₆, then 5 purple #7030A0 dots, then Ỹ_{N−2}, Y_{N−2}, Ỹ_{N−1}, Y_{N−1}.
8) Connect X row→bar and bar→Y row C with ~8 hollow white 3D 'Up' block arrows each (white fill, gray outline).
9) Add stage: 8 circles fill #CC4125 (~20px) with white bold '+', evenly spaced above the Y row; short green #00B050 arrows from the Y row into each ⊕; orange #ED7D31 curved connectors rising from the Y row and entering each ⊕ from the left (residual skips).
10) Surround this ⊕ row and the next bar with a no-fill rounded rectangle, 2pt dashed #00B050.
11) 'Layer Normalization' bar: full-width rectangle fill #F0A030 with thin darker-orange border; centered bold ~18pt text: 'Layer ' in #CC2200 followed by 'Normalization' in #5C3317.
12) Green up-arrows ⊕→bar and bar→next Y row; add Y row B (identical to step 7, with 5 purple dots).
13) FFN container: rounded rectangle, 2pt #7030A0 border, fill #F2E2F2; header strip with dark-purple #5B2C6F bold text 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden with  RELU Activation]'; below it 8 orange-bordered (#ED7D31) unit boxes, each containing ~6 green #00B050 dots on top connected by thin gray lines to ~6 pink #FF80BF dots below, plus a tiny red 'RELU' label.
14) White 3D up-arrows from Y row B into the 8 FFN unit boxes.
15) Above the FFN container add Y row A (identical to step 7); green arrows FFN→Y row A; then repeat steps 9–11 for the second ⊕ stage and second 'Layer Normalization' bar, again wrapped in a green dashed rounded rectangle.
16) Output row above the container: 16 boxes with red labels in the Ỹ/Y pair pattern and 5 blue #4472C4 dots before the final Ỹ_{N−2}, Y_{N−2}, Ỹ_{N−1}, Y_{N−1}; connect the container top to this row with 8 red #CC0000 up-arrows.
17) Top-right: yellow #FFD966 circle (~30px) with bold dark '47'.
